sections.description: Displays a styled WordPress category showcase with shortcode support, optional blog-page insertion, and editable color controls. Visit https://ravenhawktech.com for RavenHawkTech.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress and activate it. Open RavenHawkTech → Category Showcase to configure display and color settings.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • Added editable color controls for the category showcase.
  • Added editable border radius controls.
  • Converted showcase styling to CSS variables backed by WordPress options.
  • Preserved shortcode, category display, auto-insert, and RavenHawkTech admin menu behavior.

2.0.0

  • Moved plugin admin navigation under the RavenHawkTech parent menu.
  • Added RavenHawkTech admin menu and heading icons.
  • Updated plugin metadata and description for the RavenHawkTech plugin family.
